_provenance.note: Drafted from the source article by scripts/tuf/import_season.mjs, which reads the bracket templates and the episode summaries separately and joins them. Where the two disagree the bout carries no winner and the disagreement is recorded in _conflicts. Finale results are not asserted here; they are verified against our own result rows in seasons.json. House results, fight dates and classification are from the Nevada State Athletic Commission's Season 4 results record (tuf3-tuf4-nsac-reconciliation). The draft's differing values are kept in each bout's corrections; its compatible method detail is kept as secondary detail.

_conflicts.detail: The source's quarter-finals for this division do not close as a self-contained round: 1 fighter(s) appear more than once in this round. That is what a wildcard, second chance or replacement entry looks like, and also what a missing bout looks like; the bracket alone does not say which. The stated bouts are recorded as given and the round is left unverified rather than reordered into something the source does not say.

format_exceptions.detail: White announces that eliminated fighters will not leave the show, thus Rich Clementi will continue to live and train with the cast and be available as a replacement should someone drop out of the competition.

To replace the newly evicted Jeremy Jackson, Team No Love decides to flip a coin to decide which eliminated welterweight, Pete Spratt or Rich Clementi, should replace him. Jorge Rivera's coin toss allows Spratt to take Jackson's place
